message.content:
The exact amount depends on the current exchange rate, which can fluctuate throughout the day.  
As a rough estimate, if 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP (a typical rate around mid‑2024), then:

\[
20 \text{ USD} \times 0.78 \frac{\text{GBP}}{\text{USD}} \approx 15.6 \text{ GBP}
\]

So 20 US dollars would be roughly **£15–£16**. For an accurate, up‑to‑date conversion, you’d want to check a reliable financial source or a currency‑conversion tool at the time of your transaction.
